quotes.text: 1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)
3b. ¿Cuántas horas semanales trabaja habitualmente en todos sus empleos / ocupaciones...
1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?

assessments.reasoning: The survey collects information on hours devoted to paid employment/occupations (question 3b), explicitly excluding household tasks from work in question 1a. While the household questionnaire asks who performs the majority of household tasks in Section VII, question 1, it does not collect time spent on unpaid work, care, education, or leisure activities. Thus, the instrument does not ask how respondents allocate or spend their time across multiple daily activities.
